name: hud_ui_list_selector_item_on_activate
description: HudUiListSelectorItem::OnActivate notifies its selection owner through owner vtable slot 33 with the item's entry index, and does nothing when the owner is null.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4b9520 yet; tier S remains open for a later HudUiListSelectorItem/HudCmdBindButton source-file table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b9520 validates loading owner from self+0x2a8, returning when owner is null, loading entryIndex from self+0x2a4, and dispatching owner ftable slot 0x84.
Binary Ninja data xref for g_HudUiListSelectorItem_FTable validates OnActivate occupies item table slot 0.
The native smoke verifies table slot 0 registration, owner callback dispatch with the selected entry index, and null-owner no-op behavior.
